summary: Diginex Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an extension of the long-stop date for its proposed acquisition of Resulticks Global Companies Pte. Limited from May 29, 2026 to June 12, 2026. The acquisition is structured as an all-share transaction under a Sale and Purchase Agreement dated April 16, 2026. No price per share, premium, or advisor names were disclosed. The extension is intended to allow additional time to satisfy closing conditions. The acquisition remains subject to conditions and there is no assurance of completion. Investors should monitor closing condition satisfaction and any further extensions or terminations.
